Trace, implement and test: total Typing Distance

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Main {
    public static int totalTypingDistance(String s)
    {
        int n = s.length();
        int distance = 0;
        for(int i=0;i<n-1;i++)
        {
            int ch1 = s.charAt(i)-'a';
            int ch2 = s.charAt(i+1)-'a';
            distance += Math.abs(ch1-ch2);
        }
        return distance;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String s = "cba";
        int temp = totalTypingDistance(s);
        System.out.println(temp);
    }
}
